test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The mother loves the baby.

options.text: The baby was loved by the mother.
The baby will be loved by the mother.
The baby has been loved by the mother.
The baby is loved by the mother.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The baby is loved by the mother."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice.
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1(s/es) + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ is/am/are + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *She shows them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Some rare photographs are shown by her. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In this sentence, **"the baby"** is the object of the active sentence, so it becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb** "loves"** becomes **"is loved"** in the passive voice, with **"by the mother"** added at the end to show who is doing the action.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
